enabled.description: Master switch for the day-night cycle. Toggle this before loading a game to enable or disable the mod for that session.

cycle_length_minutes.description: Real-time length of one full day -> night -> day cycle, in minutes. Measured at normal game speed; higher game speeds shorten it proportionally.

min_brightness.description: How dark the deepest night gets. 0 = almost pitch black, 1 = no darkening at all.

affect_solar.description: When enabled, solar panel output follows the cycle and drops close to zero during the night (the night is only visual appearence).

vehicle_headlights.description: When enabled, vehicles cast headlight cones that light up the ground around them, switched on from sundown to sunrise.

latitude.description: Observer latitude used to place the sun and moon. Default is a northern-Africa zone. Higher values give a lower sun and longer seasonal swings.

longitude.description: Observer longitude. Default is a northern-Africa zone. Reserved for future time-zone offsetting; the sun/moon arc is driven by latitude.

sun_azimuth.description: Compass direction the sun's arc is oriented along, in degrees - it sets which way the sun rises and sets. Stored here so it persists across loads and can be changed.

moon_phase_from_sun.description: How the moon's phase (crescent, half, full) is decided. Enabled: the lit fraction follows the real angle between the sun and moon in the sky, so the shape morphs as the moon crosses. Disabled: the moon runs its own ~30-day phase cycle independent of the sun. Either way the lit side always faces the sun.

override_sun_position.description: Override the sun's position. When enabled, the sun is frozen at the elevation and azimuth set below instead of following the day-night cycle.

override_sun_elevation.description: Fixed sun height above the horizon, in degrees, used when 'override_sun_position' is enabled. Negative values put the sun below the horizon (night).

override_sun_azimuth.description: Fixed sun compass direction, in degrees, used when 'override_sun_position' is enabled.

solar_cutoff_elevation.description: Sun height above the horizon, in degrees, at which solar panels stop producing. Higher values cut solar power off earlier, before the sun visually sets; negative values keep panels running past sunset.
